rpc.note: Normal GUI reads; no invented progress or totals.
Protocol v2 pages stable history; stale/busy cursors discard partial pages and fall back to a full logical frame. A 401-message native fixture passed.
Negotiates v2, strictly reassembles UTF-8 chunks and surfaces malformed/oversized frames. Native large-frame fixture passed.
GUI uses rpc-ui and structured ask opt-in. Startup questions are replayed before initialization completes. Interactive PTYs remain a native-terminal boundary.
Bridge defaults to full native events and subagent events. Explicit controls can choose delta updates, event names and subscription level.
Fast mode requires both native model and provider support.
Native session controls; slow mode shows its reported scope. Retry uses explicit enable/disable actions because get_state does not report its current setting.
Successful session transitions broadcast fresh native history; HTML export returns a scoped download. Cancelled transitions do not replace the transcript.
Selected saved files use switch_session. --no-session is rejected for saved-chat loading rather than displaying a false empty transcript.
Advanced session diagnostics: directory sessions and native goal lifecycle/budget. Task progress is agent-owned.

rpc.surface: Settings → Session workflows → branches and checkpoints
rpc.note: Native tree/append-history selection, labels, fork/branch/navigation, optional model summaries with cancellation, compaction instructions and handoff. These actions may modify history or use the session model.

Native delivery, retry/cache controls, shell execution with context exclusion and cancellation, ownership reads and model/thinking cycling. Shell output is native; interactive PTY use is a terminal handoff.
Main-chat queue controls are deferred. Native commands remain available through expert RPC diagnostics.
Native snapshots plus lifecycle/progress events; terminal statuses are retained as reported history.
Incremental registered child transcripts, steering and cancellation. Polls are invalidated on selection/chat changes.
Provider login has a persistent browser link, native question handling and account-specific sign-out confirmation. Secret/pre-URL flows rejected by upstream RPC use Native operations → login.

Host microphone or Opus WebRTC live sessions, mute/stop and transcripts; capture-correlated draft-only dictation with insert-once and navigation cleanup. Hardware/provider acceptance remains unverified.

rpc.surface: Composer → native ghost text / Tab / Escape
rpc.note: Debounced end-of-draft prediction obeys native spelling configuration, UTF-16 cursor positions, IME/focus and stale-request guards; acceptance/rejection feedback uses the original request.
Native topic/follow-up selection, streamed turns, cancellation and restored history. Side answers stay outside the transcript.

Opt-in GUI notice tool and read-only runtime URI. Host adapters handle calls, updates/results, URI errors and cancellation; unknown registrations fail explicitly. Arbitrary third-party host behavior still requires an implementation.
Manual task mutation was intentionally removed from Session settings. Agent-owned progress remains in the conversation task plan; expert RPC access remains available.

features.name: Tool questions
features.note: rpc-ui, structured ask and startup replay are connected. The trusted native startup-question fixture passed. Interactive PTYs use the native terminal.

features.name: Slash output and native notices
features.note: Native output, notices and errors render as bounded transient output; reconnect IDs deduplicate replay.

features.name: Dialog cancellation and selection fidelity
features.note: Native cancellation/deadlines, focused initial option, option descriptions, checkbox round-trips, structured multi-answer questions and protected inputs are preserved.

features.name: Extension composer updates
features.note: Composer text has an Undo backup; widgets respect above/below placement and replay coalesces their latest values.

features.name: Lossless large RPC frames
features.note: Native v2 chunking and 401-message paged history passed in a disposable keyless profile. Invalid frames/pages fail visibly.

features.name: Goal lifecycle and agent-owned tasks
features.note: Goals remain under advanced session diagnostics. Manual task editing has been removed; task progress remains agent-owned.

features.name: Queue management
features.note: Main-chat queue controls are deferred. Native commands remain available through expert RPC diagnostics.

features.name: Subagent conversations and steering
features.note: Native event subscription, lifecycle/progress roster, incremental child transcript, steering and cancellation. No real subagent/model was spawned for verification.

features.name: Export/fork/tree completion
features.note: Scoped export download and refreshed native transitions; tree/append-history picker, labels, summaries and abort.

features.name: Provider accounts and MCP authentication
features.note: Account-specific sign-out and persistent login links. Secret/pre-URL OAuth and MCP interactive authentication retain the explicit native OMP terminal workflow. No real account changes were tested.

features.name: Settings reachability versus effect
features.note: Every native field remains searchable. All 23 missing enums have version-pinned choices and unknown future enums use native-validated text input. Global-write, terminal preference and 40 RPC-default effects are identified.

features.name: Launch flags
features.note: Quoted argv round-trips preserve Windows paths. Incompatible transport/interactive modes are rejected in GUI launches and are available through the native interactive launcher. API keys are not saved in launch flags.

features.name: Voice and dictation
features.note: UI/events, browser WebRTC/host capture, mute/stop and draft ownership are wired; fixtures cover insertion and cleanup. No microphone, realtime provider, speech engine or paid request was used.

features.name: Word completion and side questions
features.note: Native-configured ghost suffix/feedback and separate topic/follow-up stream/history controls are wired. No prediction engine or side-question model was invoked.

features.name: Host-owned tools and virtual URIs
features.note: Optional concrete GUI adapters handle request/update/result/cancel and explicit errors. Runtime URI is intentionally read-only. Arbitrary custom adapters are application code, not a JSON registration promise.

features.name: Native CLI services and administration
features.note: All 54 installed top-level commands are reachable through installed-help forms and native jobs or terminal handoffs. All 54 help routes and one isolated read-only stats job passed; mutations/services were not exercised.

features.name: Extension terminal components
features.note: Custom terminal renderers/raw-input APIs run in the explicit native OMP launcher; they are not converted to React widgets. Supported standard extension UI methods have GUI adapters.
